source_claim: Makura's first-party Sakura no Uta character pages directly identify three exact campaign Characters: Misakura Rin (御桜 稟), Natsume Shizuku (夏目 雫), and Natsume Ai (夏目 藍). The Rin and Shizuku profiles are under the official Sakura no Uta character directory; the official Ai profile is likewise published under that game's Sakura no Uta character directory. The product pages identify the work and carry Makura's copyright.
notes: Additional exact official character pages: https://www.makura-soft.com/sakuranouta/character/character_sizuku.html and https://www.makura-soft.com/sakuranouta/character/character_ai.html. Kusanagi Naoya and Honma Misuzu were not individually confirmed from the checked Sakura no Uta profile set, and Onda Nei appears associated with Sakura no Toki materials; no relation is proposed for these campaign members.
